clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money starting in March 1988, her distance from your father over money by May 1988, your brother's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts cluster around the death and the months after, with your mother's earlier anxiety about money and the distance between your parents framing the time when your brother's functioning dropped.

clusters.name: Your mother's breast cancer diagnosis, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your leaving home for college in September 1993 and your mother's diagnosis of breast cancer in February 1995, within months: your migraines in March 1994, your calls to your brother most nights in April 1994, your stopping his calls in June 1995, and your distance from your mother by February 1996. The shifts move from you toward your brother and then away from him and your mother across the period, alongside your mother's diagnosis.
